submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"

finding.headline: "The Single-Parent Mama"
finding.problem: "There's no one to hold the baby while I eat. It's just me. If I don't feed myself fast and cheap, we both fall apart."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"
finding.person: A 23-yr-old single Nigerian/diaspora mum, no partner, no helper, must cook + care solo on a tight budget; needs cheapest, fastest, one-handed nourishment.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — "Just Me & Baby: Broke, Solo & Fed — One-Handed Meals Under ₦2,000."". Verdict: PASSES (21/25)..
